project_context.purpose: EVD-0001のPlayer期待ステータスに対し、Human指定の職業別適正装備をB方式で割り当てたLv1～50の装備iLv表を固定Baseline Evidenceとして保存する。
project_context.summary: 7職×Lv1～50=350行。期待StatをRequirementへ直接適用し、装備可能な最高iLvを1..11で算出。装備性能値、HP/MP/Attack等は含めない。

authority_basis.human_equipment_profile_approval: Human explicitly corrected and approved these Player appropriate equipment assignments before EVD-0002 creation.
authority_basis.method_definition: Use EVD-0001 expected Stats directly against Current Equipment Requirements; select highest item level whose all required Stats are satisfied.
authority_basis.two_hand_rule: STR Requirement only is relaxed by x2; equivalent STR coefficient is halved for the iLv calculation.
authority_basis.armor_slot_rule: 鎧/頭/手/足 use the same Requirement coefficients, therefore the same armor iLv is assigned to all four slots.
authority_basis.human_review: All formulas and all 7-job Lv1-50 allocation results were presented before Evidence creation; Human then instructed registration as EVD-0002.
